description: This Java class implements an application listener that reacts to the ContextStartedEvent in a Spring application. It retrieves and initializes a search service bean upon application startup.

classes.name: ApplicationContextListenerUtils
classes.description: A utility class that listens for Spring application context start events and initializes the search service.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the ContextStartedEvent to retrieve the application context and initialize the search service.
